newsitem.title: USA: G7 economic policymakers to meet Feb. 8 - sources.
newsitem.headline: G7 economic policymakers to meet Feb. 8 - sources.

text.p: Finance ministers and central bank chiefs from the Group of Seven industrial nations will meet in Berlin on Feb. 8, international monetary sources said on Monday.
The sources, who declined to be identified, described the meeting as routine.

The G7 -- Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States -- traditionally meets early each year to take stock of the world economy, the currency markets and other issues of mutual interest.
